primer.notificationsBody: Crit Alarm needs notifications to ring you when something critical breaks. Without this it cannot wake you.

onboarding_connect.title: Connect your server
onboarding_connect.subtitle: Enter the address of your Crit Alarm server and its admin token. Both are printed when the server starts.
onboarding_connect.url_helper: Change this if you run your own server.
onboarding_connect.qr_notice: Scanning is not ready yet. Paste the token instead.
onboarding_connect.cloud_description: Hosted sign-in is coming. For now, connect your own server.
onboarding_connect.cloud_button: Crit Alarm Cloud is not open yet
onboarding_connect.version_incompatible: This app needs a v0.x server. Yours is {version}.
onboarding_connect.ring_body: A critical page rings and repeats every 30 s. It stops when you acknowledge it.
onboarding_connect.ring_toast_failed: Could not send the test alarm.

onboarding_permissions.denied_description: Without this, a critical page will not wake the screen and may not reach you at all.
onboarding_permissions.title:
Your server pages you.
Even at 3am.
onboarding_permissions.subtitle: A critical page wakes the screen and repeats every 30 s until you acknowledge it.
onboarding_permissions.post_notifications: Notifications, so a page can reach you.
onboarding_permissions.full_screen_intent: Full-screen alerts, so a critical page wakes the screen.
onboarding_permissions.alarm_row_granted: On. Critical alerts can ring through silent mode.
onboarding_permissions.alarm_row_denied: Off. Critical alerts will only show a notification.
onboarding_permissions.card_row_granted: On. Incidents show a card you can acknowledge.

home.title: Crit Alarm
home.stage_sub_no_topics: Create one, then point a script, cron job or monitor at its endpoint.

topic_detail.critical_toggle_subtitle: Off by default. Turn it on to repeat every 30 s until you acknowledge.
topic_detail.critical_needs_alarm: Turn on Alarms in Settings first. Without it a critical alert arrives as a quiet notification.

create_topic.title: New topic
create_topic.name_helper: Lowercase, digits, hyphens. This becomes the URL.
create_topic.critical_toggle_subtitle: Off by default. Turn it on to repeat every 30 s until you acknowledge.
create_topic.token_warning: Save this token now. It will not be shown again.
create_topic.name_error_invalid: Use 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Try prod-db.

critical_alarm.stage_sub_ringing: Ringing 2 min 14 s. Repeats every 30 s.
critical_alarm.fallback_body: pg_isready failed 3 times in 90 s. Replica promoted to primary on db-2.

settings.title: Settings
settings.stage_sub: Quiet hours on. Critical still rings.
settings.disconnect_dialog_content: You will stop receiving pages until you connect again.
settings.server_disconnected_description: Connect a server to start receiving pages.
settings.analytics_subtitle: Which screens you open. No topic names, no message content.
settings.crash_reports_subtitle: What the app was doing when it crashed, plus your device model.

device_permissions.title: Device permissions
device_permissions.stage_sub_all_granted: All set. Ready to wake you at 3am.
device_permissions.stage_sub_required: Some pages will not reach you until these are on.
device_permissions.item_notifications_description: Off means no page reaches you.
device_permissions.item_full_screen_intent_description: Off means a critical page will not wake the screen.
device_permissions.item_battery_optimization_description: Off means pages can arrive late.

paywall.self_hosted_note: Self-hosting? Every critical alert is free.
paywall.feedback_no_active_restored: Nothing to restore on this account.
